newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$2.6 billion bonds due 2002.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$2.6 billion bonds due 2002.

text.p: The Government of Canada said on Thursday it plans to auction on May 28 a total C$2.6 billion of bonds with a coupon of 5.5 percent and maturing on September 1, 2002.
The Bank of Canada will buy a minimum of C$390 million of the new bonds

The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on June 2, pay interest on September 1 and March 1, the government said. The bonds will be issued with accrued interest from March 3, 1997 to June 2, 1997.
Proceeds of the issue will be used for general purposes.
The government said the new bonds are in addition to C$2.7 billion of 5.5 percent bonds due September 2002 already outstanding.
